title: Pilot Stage-1 source feasibility and canonical field map
objective: Close decision-changing public source and mechanism gaps, produce a dated claim-evidence graph and field-level canonical mapping, and convert access-dependent or empirical unknowns into exact gates.
business_reason: The vertical slice must use lawful, Stage-1-available physical-location evidence without converting source metadata into coverage or predictive claims.
known_bad_cases: metadata page treated as row-level access
acceptance: every material claim is dated and source-linked
each source records grain, clocks, access, terms, and Stage-1 risks

completed: Toronto licence package metadata and schema-only reproduction

rollback: Revert to the last accepted registry and quarantine evidence whose provenance or permitted use changes.
stop_budget: Stop public research when each decision is supported, rejected, or converted to an exact gate; do not collect redundant sources.
